text:
```yaml
name: Godot Addon Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Restore godot/ source directory
      run: git checkout -- godot/

    - name: Remove amy_midi.c and add MIDI stubs
      run: |
        rm godot/addons/amy/src/amy_midi.c
        echo '#include "amy_platform_stubs.h"' >> godot/addons/amy/src/amy_platform_stubs.c

    - name: Build Godot addon
      run: |
        cd godot
        scons platform=${{ matrix.os }} tools=yes

    - name: Zip build artifacts
      if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      run: |
        Compress-Archive -Path addons/amy/bin/* -DestinationPath addons/amy/bin.zip

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: godot-addon-${{ matrix.os }}
        path: godot/addons/amy/bin/
```
